questions.stem: 在每位護理師得照顧十多位病人的醫院，對護理師來說，要準時下班非常困難。
questions.answer: In hospitals where each nurse must look after over ten patients, it is very difficult for nurses to finish their shifts on time.
accepted_answers: In hospitals where every nurse has to take care of more than ten patients, it is extremely hard for nurses to get off work on time.
In hospitals where one nurse has to care for over ten patients, it is very hard for the nurses to leave work on time.

patterns: 虛主詞 It＋形容詞＋不定詞

questions.stem: 面對嚴重的人力短缺，許多醫院開始思考，低薪是否為護理師離職的主要原因。
questions.answer: Facing a severe shortage of staff, many hospitals have begun to consider whether low pay is the main reason why nurses quit.
accepted_answers: Faced with a serious staff shortage, many hospitals have started to wonder whether low salaries are the main reason nurses leave their jobs.
Facing a severe shortage of nurses, many hospitals are beginning to ask whether low wages are the major cause of nurses quitting.

1.explanation_zh: 「在每位護理師得照顧十多位病人的醫院」修飾「醫院」的子句很長，英文用關係副詞 where 後位修飾：In hospitals where each nurse must look after over ten patients,（where 後面是完整子句）。「對護理師來說，要準時下班非常困難」用虛主詞 it：it is very difficult for nurses to finish their shifts on time，「對…來說」寫成 for + 人，放在 to VR 前面。「準時下班」是 leave work／finish their shifts on time，「準時」是 on time。
evidence: 在每位護理師得照顧十多位病人的醫院
1.strategy_zh: 「在…的地方」→ the place where + 完整子句；「要…很困難」→ It is difficult for + 人 + to VR。
hints: 切成四段：在每位護理師得照顧十多位病人的醫院／對護理師來說／要準時下班／非常困難
標的詞彙：hospital（醫院）、nurse（護理師）、look after（照顧）、patient（病人）、difficult（困難的）、finish（結束）、shift（班）、on time（準時）
句型框架：In + N + where + S + V …, it is very difficult for + N + to VR …

2.explanation_zh: 「面對嚴重的人力短缺」省略的主詞是後面的「許多醫院」，用分詞構句 Facing a severe shortage of staff,（或 Faced with …）；「人力」是 staff／manpower，不要寫 human power。「開始思考…是否為…」是間接問句：have begun to consider whether …，whether 後面用直述句語序 low pay is …，pay 不可數，動詞用 is。「護理師離職的主要原因」是 the main reason (why) nurses quit，reason 後面接 why 子句或 for + N。
evidence: 低薪是否為護理師離職的主要原因
2.strategy_zh: 句首「面對…」且主詞在後→分詞構句；「是否」→ whether + 直述句。
hints: 切成四段：面對嚴重的人力短缺／許多醫院開始思考／低薪是否為／護理師離職的主要原因
標的詞彙：face（面對）、severe（嚴重的）、shortage（短缺）、staff（人力）、hospital（醫院）、begin（開始）、consider（思考）、low（低的）、pay（薪資）、main（主要的）、reason（原因）、nurse（護理師）、quit（離職）
句型框架：V-ing + N, S + have begun to consider whether + S + is + the main reason (why) + S + V

references: In hospitals where each nurse must look after over ten patients, it is very difficult for nurses to finish their shifts on time.
In hospitals where every nurse has to take care of more than ten patients, it is extremely hard for nurses to get off work on time.
In hospitals where one nurse has to care for over ten patients, it is very hard for the nurses to leave work on time.

bonus.text: So heavy is the workload in hospitals where each nurse must look after over ten patients that finishing a shift on time is almost unheard of.
bonus.explanation_zh: So + 形容詞置首倒裝（So heavy is the workload … that …）強調工作量之重，unheard of（前所未聞）誇飾「幾乎不可能準時下班」。屬加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「在…的醫院」修飾語很長，英文用關係副詞 where 放在 hospitals 後面：In hospitals where each nurse must look after …；「對護理師來說，要準時下班非常困難」用虛主詞句 it is very difficult for nurses to …，不要讓 nurses 當 difficult 的主詞。
1.notes_zh: 第 1 部分寫 in which 也可以（＝where）；「十多位」寫 over ten、more than ten 都可以。第 2 部分寫 for them 也可以（them 指護理師）。第 4 部分 very difficult、very hard、extremely difficult 都可以；「準時下班」寫 leave work／get off work／finish their shifts on time 都可以。寫成 nurses find it very hard to … 是虛受詞句，沒有用到虛主詞 It is … to VR，不在可接受寫法內。

traps.literal_error: Facing a severe human power shortage, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「人力短缺」是複合概念，英文是 a shortage of staff／manpower；照字面把「人力」譯成 human power 意思不對。

traps.literal_error: … many hospitals have begun to consider whether is low pay the main reason …
traps.explanation_zh: 「是否為…」照疑問句語序寫成 whether is low pay … 是錯的；間接問句要用直述句語序 whether low pay is …。

bonus.text: Faced with a severe shortage of staff, many hospitals are asking themselves whether it is low pay that drives nurses away.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用強調句 it is low pay that … 聚焦「低薪」這個可能的主因，drive … away（把人逼走）比 quit 更生動。屬加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「面對…」省略的主詞就是後面的「許多醫院」，用分詞構句 Facing a severe shortage of staff,；「思考…是否…」是間接問句，whether 後面用直述句語序 low pay is …；「護理師離職的主要原因」寫成 the main reason (why) nurses quit。
2.notes_zh: 第 1 部分 Facing 和 Faced with 都可以；「人力短缺」寫 a shortage of staff／manpower／nurses 都可以。第 3 部分 whether 也可用 if。第 4 部分寫 the main reason why nurses quit、the main reason for nurses leaving their jobs、the main cause of nurses quitting 都可以。寫成 Because of a severe shortage of staff, … 沒有用到分詞構句，不在可接受寫法內。

1.translation: In hospitals where each nurse has to take care of more than ten patients, it is very difficult for nurses to leave work on time.
1.explanation_zh: 「在每位護理師得照顧…的醫院」用關係副詞 where 修飾 hospitals；「對護理師來說，要準時下班非常困難」用 it is very difficult for … to …；「準時下班」用 leave work on time。

2.translation: Faced with a serious staff shortage, many hospitals have begun to consider whether low pay is the main reason why nurses quit their jobs.
2.explanation_zh: 「面對」用 Faced with；「開始思考是否」用 have begun to consider whether；「護理師離職的主要原因」用 the main reason why nurses quit their jobs。

1.translation: In hospitals where each nurse has to take care of more than ten patients, it is very difficult for nurses to get off work on time.
1.explanation_zh: 「在……的醫院」用 In hospitals where ...；「得照顧十多位病人」用 has to take care of more than ten patients；「對護理師來說，要……非常困難」用虛主詞 it is very difficult for nurses to ...；「準時下班」get off work on time。

2.translation: Faced with a serious shortage of staff, many hospitals have begun to wonder whether low pay is the main reason why nurses quit their jobs.
2.explanation_zh: 「面對嚴重的人力短缺」用過去分詞構句 Faced with ...；「開始思考……是否」用 have begun to wonder whether ...；「離職的主要原因」用 the main reason why nurses quit their jobs。
